notes: In 4.26.0 I refused to hand model values to the optimiser as expected returns without an explicit "price converges to modelled value" assumption, because model / price − 1 is the size of a disagreement, not a forecast. The instinct was right. The construction was wrong. I offered a binary — refuse, or assert — when practice has had a third answer since 1990.
